scope: Spline pcalvol tight acceptance only. 3D Bayesian phi_h in the copy of fits/spline/pcalvol/tight/fit_copy.root, Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. The file has rdf, mdf, gdf, Background, and Bayesian histograms and no RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, Bin, or 5D histograms. Those families were not created. No publication. The source fit, the budget, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. This copy does not replace the source, so the source stays in the budget. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json, so this is not a resume.
start_mode: manual. start=auto: the 3D spline B windows selected by these histograms have median width 0.0153 and 428 of 452 are narrower than 0.05, and the C windows have median width 0.0070 with 445 of 452 narrower than 0.05, so they can pin a fit. The run-local guide started as Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_Initialize.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Pass 1 used the manual baseline on all 452 histograms. It improved 6 and made 24 worse. The manual window, or the second-pass half-width around a bad start, pulled bins off this histogram's cosine. The worst stored miss that pass 1 did not fix was (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8). Pass 1 moved it only from B=-0.045000 to B=-0.061369, collapsed C to 0, and changed chi-squared from 77.869 to 76.807. That is still short of this histogram's cosine B=-0.118043, C=-0.039354, chi-squared 73.750. The worst pass-1 regression was (Q2_y_Bin_13)-(z_pT_Bin_4), chi-squared 38.817 to 266.974. Pass 2 put 55 starts on each histogram's own unconstrained cosine, opened only the limits that excluded that cosine, and turned off the second-pass half-width when it was narrower than the parameter error. It refit Q2-y 1 through 16. Q2-y 17 was not given new keys and did not move. JSON still has 452 bins. 35 histograms have a lower chi-squared than the stored fit and none is worse (largest increase 0.0007). (1, 8) is kept at B=-0.118038, statistical error 0.035582, C=-0.039352, error 0.032993, chi-squared 73.750, NDF 13, status completed, phi 60-300, 16 histogram bins inside the TF1 range. The stored B=-0.045 was the second-pass edge of a first-pass limit at -0.05, not the cosine. It is not pulled to the nominal B=-0.125184.

(Q2_y_Bin_10)-(z_pT_Bin_15) is 0.479 above the free cosine, inside the B statistical error 0.010, and was left. Excluded sector pairs were not put back into this comparison.
